extDescription.message: Back up, restore, import, export, and organize tabs and bookmarks.

popupSubtitle.message: Tabs and bookmarks, safely backed up.

incompatibleBackupFile.message: This is not a compatible Organizer backup.

aiAccessRequired.message: AI access is required for the selected organization method. You can choose the offline method in Settings.

creatingBackupSendingAi.message: Creating a safety backup and sending links to the AI…

aiProcessingTicker.message: AI job is processing… $1s. You can keep this popup open.

aiProcessingStarted.message: AI processing started for $1 $2. You can close this popup; Organizer will continue in the background.

tabsOrganizedSuccess.message: Tabs organized; a backup was saved first.

bookmarksOrganizedSuccess.message: Bookmarks organized; a backup was saved first.

couldNotCancelAiJob.message: Could not cancel the AI job.

errorGeneric.message: Organizer could not complete this action.

errorBackgroundRestarted.message: Organizer's background process restarted. Reopen the popup to see the saved AI job and its latest progress.

errorBackgroundUnavailable.message: Organizer's background process is unavailable. Reopen the popup; if this continues, reload the extension and try again.

errorAiTimeoutFriendly.message: The AI service is taking longer than expected. No tabs or bookmarks were changed, and remaining AI batches were cancelled. Please try again later.

errorNetworkUnreachable.message: Organizer could not reach the AI service. Check your connection and try again; no tabs or bookmarks were changed.

errorBackgroundGone.message: The extension background process did not respond. Reload the extension and try again.

errorAiJobFailed.message: The AI job could not be completed.

optionsLead.message: Choose how tabs and bookmarks are categorized.

bookmarkScopeLabel.message: Only organize items at the top level

bookmarkScopeNote.message: Recommended. Loose bookmarks and folders sitting directly in the toolbar or Other Bookmarks are grouped into new category folders, and each folder's own contents stay together. Bookmarks already nested inside another folder are left untouched. Turn this off to recategorize your entire bookmark library instead.

tabFallbackReorder.message: Reorder tabs in the current window (default)

tabFallbackNote.message: Chrome uses native tab groups when available. This fallback is used by Firefox and other browsers without tab-group support.

closeDuplicateTabsNote.message: Keep the first tab for each identical URL. A tab-session backup is created before closing duplicates.

removeDuplicateBookmarksNote.message: Keep the first bookmark for each identical URL. A bookmark backup is created before removing duplicates.

aiNotice.message: With AI organization, tab or bookmark titles and URLs are sent to the selected provider. API keys stay in extension local storage and are sent only to that provider. Dave AI receives bounded link data and never accepts arbitrary prompts.

aiAccessNotGranted.message: AI access was not granted; settings were not changed.

builtinCategoriesNotice.message: Offline recognition includes 10,000 popular domains plus titles, metadata, and domain keywords.

aboutNotice.message: Learn more about Organizer, its privacy-first design, and how donations help maintain our optional AI servers.

bgNoRestorableTabs.message: There are no restorable tabs in this window.

bgJobAlreadyRunning.message: An AI organization job is already running.

bgAiInvalidResponse.message: The AI returned an invalid response.

bgAiTimedOut.message: The AI request timed out before every processing batch finished.

bgNoBookmarkRoots.message: No bookmark locations were found to restore into.

bgAddApiKey.message: Add your $1 API key in Settings.

bgBookmarksSkipped.message: $1 bookmarks no longer existed and were skipped.
